items.name: +2 Status to All Saves vs. Disease and Poison
Not Done With You!
items.text:
Trigger A creature within Baulrica's reach leaves a square during a move action it's using

---
Effect Baulrica attempts to grapple the creature. On a success, the creature is also Frightened 1.

items.name: Beat Down
items.text: Baulrica makes two fist Strikes against a single target. Both Strikes count toward Baulrica's multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after both attacks. If she hits with both Strikes, the target must also succeed at a DC 30 Fortitude save save or be knocked Prone.

items.name: Eye Gouge
items.text: If Baulrica's last action was a successful fist Strike against a creature, Baulrica jabs her fingers into that creature's eyes. The creature attempts a DC 30 Fortitude save save. On a failed save, the creature takes 2d6 persistent,bleed damage. On a critical failure, the creature is also Blinded for as long as the persistent damage lasts.
